Package index

Acesso aos dados / Data access

API das séries harmonizadas; cada função retorna um tibble no esquema comum de inst/dict/schema.yaml. / Harmonized-series API; each function returns a tibble following the common schema in inst/dict/schema.yaml.

get_enrollment()
Brazilian school-enrollment series
get_schooling()
Brazilian mean years of schooling
get_expenditure()
Brazilian public expenditure on education
get_progression()
Brazilian grade-progression series
get_attainment()
Comparative international educational-attainment series

Citação e proveniência / Citation and provenance

Descubra e cite as fontes originais, além do pacote. / Discover and cite the original sources as well as the package.

list_sources()
List the data sources bundled with educabr2
educabr_cite()
Generate citations for educabr2 data sources

Visualização / Visualization

Tema ggplot2, paleta Okabe-Ito segura para daltonismo e eixo de anos para séries históricas. / A ggplot2 theme, colourblind-safe Okabe-Ito palette and year axis for historical series.

theme_educabr()
educabr2 Visualization Theme
scale_colour_educabr() scale_fill_educabr()
educabr2 Color Scales (Okabe-Ito)
scale_x_year_educabr()
Year Axis Scale for Historical Series

Painel / Dashboard

Abra o painel Shiny local ou consulte o painel público. / Launch the local Shiny app or visit the public dashboard.

run_dashboard()
Launch the educabr2 Shiny dashboard

Conjuntos de dados / Backing datasets

Objetos distribuídos com o pacote. Prefira as funções get_*() para filtrar, normalizar o esquema e traduzir rótulos. / Objects bundled with the package. Prefer get_*() to filter, normalize the schema and translate labels.

enrollment_kang_fgv
Enrollment series — Kang / FGV-IBRE 2023 compilation
enrollment_tertiary
Tertiary (ensino superior) enrollment — multi-source compilation
schooling_kang_fgv
Mean years of schooling — Walter & Kang 2024 compilation
expenditure_kang_fgv
Public expenditure on education — Kang & Menetrier 2024 compilation
progression_kang_fgv
Grade-progression series (GDR6) — Kang, Paese & Felix 2021 compilation
lee_lee_2016
Comparative international educational attainment — Lee & Lee 2016
